parameters.query:
SELECT q.id, q.quote_raw, q.quote_check_retry_count, b.title, b.author
FROM quotes q
JOIN books b ON b.id = q.book_id
WHERE b.aladin_status = 'validated'
  AND q.quote_check_status IN ('staged', 'retry_wait')
  AND q.quote_check_next_retry_at <= NOW()
ORDER BY q.quote_check_next_retry_at, q.id
LIMIT 10;

const row = $input.first().json; const apiKey = typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env && process.env.GROQ_API_KEY ? process.env.GROQ_API_KEY : 'YOUR_GROQ_API_KEY'; const model = 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile'; const backoffSteps = [1, 3, 10, 30, 120]; const nextRetryCount = Number(row.quote_check_retry_count || 0) + 1; const nextRetryAt = new Date(Date.now() + backoffSteps[Math.min(nextRetryCount - 1, backoffSteps.length - 1)] * 60000).toISOString(); const prompt = `다음 문장을 검수하세요.

책: ${row.title} (${row.author})
문장: ${row.quote_raw}

판정 기준:
- 실제 책 문장으로 보이는지
- 문자 깨짐이나 메타 텍스트가 없는지
- 문장으로서 자연스러운지

반드시 아래 JSON 객체만 반환하세요.
{"valid":true,"reason":null,"issues":["문제없음"]}`; const response = await fetch('https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ model, temperature: 0.1, max_tokens: 250, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }] }) }).catch(error => ({ ok: false, status: 0, json: async () => ({ error: { message: error.message } }) })); const payload = typeof response.json === 'function' ? await response.json().catch(() => ({})) : {}; if (!response.ok) { return [{ json: { ...row, quote_check_status: 'retry_wait', quote_check_retry_count: nextRetryCount, quote_check_next_retry_at: nextRetryAt, quote_check_error_reason: payload?.error?.message || `quote_review_${response.status}` } }]; } const text = payload?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || ''; const cleaned = text.replace(/```json\s*/gi, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim(); const start = cleaned.indexOf('{'); const end = cleaned.lastIndexOf('}'); if (start === -1 || end === -1 || end <= start) { return [{ json: { ...row, quote_check_status: 'needs_review', quote_check_retry_count: row.quote_check_retry_count || 0, quote_check_next_retry_at: new Date().toISOString(), quote_check_error_reason: 'quote_review_parse_failed' } }]; } let result; try { result = JSON.parse(cleaned.slice(start, end + 1)); } catch (error) { return [{ json: { ...row, quote_check_status: 'needs_review', quote_check_retry_count: row.quote_check_retry_count || 0, quote_check_next_retry_at: new Date().toISOString(), quote_check_error_reason: `quote_review_json:${error.message}` } }]; } if (result.valid === true) { return [{ json: { ...row, quote_check_status: 'validated', quote_check_retry_count: 0, quote_check_next_retry_at: new Date().toISOString(), quote_check_error_reason: null, quote_checked_at: new Date().toISOString() } }]; } return [{ json: { ...row, quote_check_status: 'needs_review', quote_check_retry_count: row.quote_check_retry_count || 0, quote_check_next_retry_at: new Date().toISOString(), quote_check_error_reason: result.reason || 'quote_review_invalid' } }];

parameters.query:
UPDATE quotes
SET quote_check_status = '{{ $json.quote_check_status }}',
    quote_check_retry_count = {{ $json.quote_check_retry_count || 0 }},
    quote_check_next_retry_at = '{{ $json.quote_check_next_retry_at }}'::timestamp,
    quote_check_error_reason = {{ $json.quote_check_error_reason ? "'" + $json.quote_check_error_reason.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    quote_checked_at = {{ $json.quote_checked_at ? "'" + $json.quote_checked_at + "'::timestamp" : 'quote_checked_at' }}
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};
